applicability: One synthetic operating day with declared finite shifts, workers, children, care offers, staffing and payer constraints.
Explicit new-cohort and roster combination with full finite cost obligations and prefunded declared contingencies.
Mutually exclusive scenarios with the provider outage disclosed before care begins.
The monthly package requires its own repeated-day construction and validation; this manifest does not imply general monthly delivery.
artifact_kind: Public source code made available for local assessment; no retained network skill admitted

authentication_scope.binding: Exact manifest and code hashes, declared public rights, named recipient, fixed research mission and short expiry
authentication_scope.identity_resolution: Local fixture names ending .agent.agi.eth; no live ENS lookup
authentication_scope.secrets: Ephemeral private signing keys exist only during the local run; public keys and signatures may be retained

dependencies.research_fixture: Existing successor TrustRegistry using cryptography and pydantic; no new native API or role

economic_interpretation: Operating delivery economics and proposed retained-instrument economics are separate. No positive incremental retained value, actual sales, real funding or operational gain is established by this manifest or signature fixture.
evidence_interpretation: References bind existing local files only. The fixture does not read or transfer held-out economic worlds or evaluation answers, and does not claim v2 fresh technical confirmation from v1 evidence.
failure_modes: Code verifies only the stated finite synthetic domain, not truth of constraints or real provider capability.
Legal requirements, actual care availability, consent and enforceable contracting require their own source-supported validation.
Simultaneous provider failure, late or mid-session shocks, unmodeled skill needs and changed mission semantics are outside this guarantee.
Hash equality and local signatures do not establish safety, source truth, market demand, live identity or positive incremental value.

mechanism_adaptation.scope: Reuse the actual native signature/trust mechanism. No geospatial evaluation outcome, authority or economic claim is inherited.

name: Finite joint roster and new-cohort commitment package constructor with separate checker

ordinary_library_control.interpretation: Identical public code is freely available to the ordinary library control. No code-access advantage or performance gain follows from the authenticated route.

reuse_recheck_regrant.recheck: Input meaning, public rights, constraints, costs, source versions, mission and acceptance criteria must be rechecked for any new use.
reuse_recheck_regrant.regrant: Research access is not execution or service authorization. Existing owners and native roles must separately grant any later supported authority.
reuse_recheck_regrant.reuse: Exact public v2 constructor/checker source bytes can be assessed by either path.
